text: The striking cartoon vividly presents a magnificent scene in which barren hills turn into lush green forests, with fish swimming freely in crystal-clear rivers.
Simple as the picture may seem, it delivers a clear message: ecological protection is an indispensable prerequisite for the sustainable progress of humanity.
A host of compelling arguments account for the urgency of green development.
Chief among these is that reckless exploitation of natural resources disrupts the delicate natural balance, yet short-sighted companies often fail to weigh the severe cost.
As an old proverb warns, "An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure."
Relying solely on slogans is far from enough to protect nature; instead, adopting low-carbon lifestyles and clean energy not only safeguards biodiversity, but also drives long-term economic growth.
In conclusion, economic advancement must never be pursued at the heavy expense of a damaged environment.
Strict laws should curb reckless pollution, while ordinary citizens are expected to practice green habits conscientiously.
Only in harmony with nature can mankind conquer ecological crises and secure a green, promising future.
